sections.Profile:
Playmatic released two versions of the "Black Flag" pinball machine, a single-player model in 1973 and a four-player version in 1975. Both machines share the same playfield layout, featuring two flippers, three pop bumpers, one slingshot, five captive balls, two standup targets, a kick-out hole, and a right-side kicker lane.

- Manufacturer: Playmatic
- Years made: 1973–1975
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
